title.en: How to say what a pile of numbers looks like
title.zh: 怎样说清一堆数字长什么样

description.en: Two numbers for the middle, two for the spread: the ones that survive an outlier and the ones that do not. Drag dots to see which number moves, then compute them the way the exam expects, with a calculator and the sample formula.
description.zh: 描述中间的两个数、描述离散程度的两个数：哪些经得起极端值、哪些经不起。拖动圆点，看哪个数在动；然后按考试的要求，用计算器和样本公式算出来。

name.zh: 描述数据：位置与离散程度

description.en: Using the mean to summarise data with an extreme value
description.zh: 数据里有极端值，还用平均数来概括

description.en: Dividing the sum of squared deviations by n instead of n − 1 for a sample
description.zh: 样本方差除以 n 而不是 n − 1

description.en: Thinking two groups with the same mean are alike
description.zh: 以为平均数相同的两组就差不多

text.en: A bank has seven staff. Six earn £20k to £80k a year; the seventh, the CEO, earns £4.5 million. The dots are the salaries (in £ thousands); the red triangle is the **mean** and the green bar the **median**. Drag the CEO’s dot and watch both.
text.zh: 一家银行有七名员工。六个人年薪在 £20k 到 £80k 之间；第七个是 CEO，年薪 £450 万。圆点是各人的工资（单位千英镑）；红三角是**平均数**，绿杠是**中位数**。拖动 CEO 的圆点，看两者怎么动。

alt.en: Seven salaries on a line, with their mean and median.
alt.zh: 一条线上的七份工资，以及它们的平均数和中位数。

caption.en: Drag a dot sideways (the arrow keys work too).
caption.zh: 左右拖动圆点（也可以用方向键）。

prompt.en: The CEO’s pay is cut from £4.5 million to £100k. What happens to the median and the mean?
prompt.zh: CEO 的年薪从 £450 万降到 £10 万。中位数和平均数会怎样？

label.en: The median stays at £30k; the mean falls from about £675k to about £46k.
label.zh: 中位数仍是 £30k；平均数从约 £675k 降到约 £46k。

label.en: Both fall by the same amount.

feedback.en: The median only looks at the middle value; the CEO is not in the middle either way.
feedback.zh: 中位数只看中间那个值；CEO 不管怎样都不在中间。

feedback.en: The mean adds every value, so it follows the CEO.
feedback.zh: 平均数把每个值都加进去，所以会跟着 CEO 走。

explain.en: The mean is pulled by every value, extremes most. The median is the middle one and ignores how far the ends go: it is *robust*.
explain.zh: 平均数受每个值影响，极端值影响最大。中位数是中间那个，不管两端有多远：它是*稳健*的。

rows.en: the middle value of the sorted data (odd $n$); the average of the two middle values (even $n$)
rows.zh: 排序后的中间值（$n$ 为奇数）；中间两个值的平均（$n$ 为偶数）

rows.en: sort; $i = \tfrac{p}{100} n$; if $i$ is not whole, round **up** to that position; if whole, average positions $i$ and $i+1$
rows.zh: 排序；$i = \tfrac{p}{100} n$；$i$ 不是整数就**向上**取整到那个位置；是整数就取第 $i$ 和第 $i+1$ 位的平均

rows.en: Q3 − Q1: the range of the middle half
rows.zh: Q3 − Q1：中间一半数据的极差

text.en: For a **sample** divide by $n - 1$, not $n$: that makes $s^2$ an unbiased estimate of the population variance (the formula sheet of the paper gives it). The variance is in squared units (dollars squared); the standard deviation takes the square root and is back in dollars. Numbers computed from a sample are *statistics*; from a whole population, *parameters*.
text.zh: **样本**要除以 $n - 1$，不是 $n$：这样 $s^2$ 才是总体方差的无偏估计（试卷的公式表里有）。方差的单位是平方单位（美元的平方）；标准差开方后又回到美元。由样本算出的数叫*统计量*；由整个总体算出的叫*参数*。

title.en: The graduates’ salaries as the lecture works it
title.zh: 课上的例子：毕业生起薪

body.en: Twelve starting salaries: mean \$3,540; median \$3,505; mode \$3,480; Q1 \$3,465, Q3 \$3,600, IQR \$135; 85th percentile: $i = 0.85 \times 12 = 10.2$, round up to the 11th value, \$3,730; $\sum (x - \bar x)^2 = 301{,}850$, so $s^2 = 301850/11 = 27,440.9$ and $s = \$165.65$.

title.zh: 平均数相同，供应商不同

text.en: A purchasing agent orders from two suppliers. Both deliver in 10.3 days on average. Which is more reliable? The means cannot say; the spread can.
text.zh: 采购员向两个供应商订货。两家的平均交货时间都是 10.3 天。哪家更可靠？平均数回答不了，离散程度能回答。

alt.en: Lead times of two suppliers with the same mean, with the box of the middle half and the standard deviation.
alt.zh: 两个平均数相同的供应商的交货时间，带有中间一半的方框和标准差。

caption.en: Move a dot of Clark’s to the middle and watch the IQR and s shrink.
caption.zh: 把 Clark 的一个圆点移到中间，看 IQR 和 s 缩小。

say.en: The ten lead times add up to 103 days.
say.zh: 十个交货时间加起来是 103 天。

say.en: Each deviation from 10.3, squared: $0.49, 0.09, 1.69, \ldots$; their sum is 4.1.
say.zh: 每个数与 10.3 的偏差的平方：$0.49, 0.09, 1.69, \ldots$；加起来是 4.1。

say.en: The standard deviation, back in days. (Clark’s is 2.58.)
say.zh: 标准差，单位又回到天。（Clark 的是 2.58。）

outro.en: **Answer:** Dawson $s = 0.67$ days and IQR 1 day; Clark $s = 2.58$ days and IQR 4 days. Dawson is the more consistent and reliable supplier: both measures of spread are smaller, with the same mean.
outro.zh: **答案：** Dawson 的 $s = 0.67$ 天、IQR 为 1 天；Clark 的 $s = 2.58$ 天、IQR 为 4 天。Dawson 更稳定可靠：平均数相同，两个离散度量都更小。

prompt.en: Dawson and Clark both average 10.3 days. What does that tell you about which supplier to pick?
prompt.zh: Dawson 和 Clark 的平均交货时间都是 10.3 天。这对选哪个供应商有什么帮助？

label.en: Nothing about reliability: you need the spread (IQR or s).
label.zh: 对可靠性没有帮助：要看离散程度（IQR 或 s）。

feedback.en: The same average hides a very different spread: 4 days against 1 day IQR.
feedback.zh: 相同的平均数藏着非常不同的离散程度：IQR 一个是 4 天，一个是 1 天。

label.en: Pick the one with the larger range.

feedback.zh: 极差大意味着*更不*稳定。

explain.en: A mean says where the middle is, not how far from it a delivery can land.
explain.zh: 平均数说中间在哪儿，不说一次交货能偏离它多远。

text.en: Ages of 20 people who work from home: 18, 20, 25, 25, 25, 26, 27, 27, 28, 33, 36, 37, 40, 40, 42, 45, 46, 48, 53, 54 (sorted). Mean 34.75, mode 25, median $(33 + 36)/2 = 34.5$: the at-home workers are only slightly younger than the median adult (36). For the quartiles, $n = 20$: $i = 0.25 \times 20 = 5$ is whole, so Q1 averages the 5th and 6th values.

prompt.en: For those 20 ages, what is Q3 (the 75th percentile)?
prompt.zh: 这 20 个年龄的 Q3（第 75 百分位数）是多少？

explain.en: $i = 0.75 \times 20 = 15$ is a whole number, so average the 15th and 16th values: $(42 + 45)/2 = 43.5$.

prompt.en: What is the 32nd percentile of the 20 ages?
prompt.zh: 这 20 个年龄的第 32 百分位数是多少？

explain.en: $i = 0.32 \times 20 = 6.4$ is not whole, so round up to the 7th value: 27. At least 32% of these people are 27 or younger.
explain.zh: $i = 0.32 \times 20 = 6.4$ 不是整数，向上取整到第 7 个值：27。这些人里至少有 32% 是 27 岁或更小。

body.en: A sample variance divides by $n - 1$. The exam gives the formula, but a calculator’s “σₙ” key divides by $n$: use the key for the **sample** standard deviation (written s, sx or sₙ₋₁ depending on the model) and check the answer once by hand.
body.zh: 样本方差要除以 $n - 1$。考试会给公式，但计算器上的“σₙ”键是除以 $n$：要用**样本**标准差键（不同型号写作 s、sx 或 sₙ₋₁），并且手算验证一次。

body.en: Percentiles are read from the **sorted** list. A non-whole index is always rounded **up**.
body.zh: 百分位数要从**排好序的**数据里读。不是整数的位置一律**向上**取整。

body.en: A mark is usually given for the sentence: “Dawson’s lead times are more consistent because both IQR and s are smaller.”
body.zh: 通常有一分是给那句话的：“Dawson 的交货时间更稳定，因为 IQR 和 s 都更小。”

prompt.en: EVwoPI is 28 and EVwPI is 25.75 for a travel-time problem. EVPI is:
prompt.zh: 一个行程时间问题里 EVwoPI 是 28，EVwPI 是 25.75。EVPI 是：

feedback.en: That is EVwPI, not the gap.

prompt.en: A report gives a cost coefficient 9 with allowable increase 2.33 and allowable decrease 3. The current plan stays optimal for a cost between:
prompt.zh: 报告给出成本系数 9，允许增量 2.33，允许减量 3。当成本在什么范围内，现有计划仍然最优：

feedback.en: That swaps the increase and decrease.
feedback.zh: 那是把增量和减量弄反了。

feedback.en: The range runs both ways from the coefficient.
feedback.zh: 范围是从系数向两边延伸。
